notes_for_editor: Name conflict: the tnlandforms list says Huntsville (NCT093); the Eastern US Lookouts page says Huntersville Mountain, McDowell County, with a 1940 CCC entry. Treated as possibly one tower, not confirmed. A WLOS report of a December 2021 wildfire on Huntsville Mountain in McDowell County (https://www.wlos.com/news/local/slow-moving-mcdowell-huntsville-mountain-fire-70-percent-contained-350-acres-no-injuries-reported) does not mention a tower and is left out of the story. The 52-foot figure is the tower height in the source; not confirmed as height to the cab floor. The 1942 state report was cited by the Eastern page but not opened. Only two web searches were run; no register or agency record was found.
